question: Cherry Creek Estate avocado oil company owner manufacturer
markdown:
Cherry Creek Estate
is an integrated agricultural producer and manufacturer located near Blackbutt in Queensland, Australia. It is co-founded and managed by orchard manager
Cody Dennis
, operating as an Australian veteran-founded and supported enterprise that grows avocados and cold-presses its own 100% pure extra virgin avocado oil on-site.
Cherry Creek Estate
Company & Manufacturing Details
Location:
25 Corcoran Road, Cherry Creek, QLD 4314, Australia

Leadership / Key Personnel:
Cody Dennis (Co-founder and manager).
Core Products:
100% pure cold-pressed extra virgin avocado oil, alongside macadamias and ginger.
